# SirenVenue

> SirenVenue s. r. o. is a small studio in Bratislava, Slovakia. It designs and builds modern, made-to-measure solutions for individuals and small businesses: websites and web apps, internal tools and automation, live video and camera systems, and hosting and care after launch.

The site is published in Slovak (primary) and seven other languages. Each page exists under /{locale}, for example /sk and /en.

## Pages

- [Home (Slovak)](https://sirenvenue.sk/sk): what we do and what is on the bench now
- [Home (English)](https://sirenvenue.sk/en)
- [About](https://sirenvenue.sk/en/about): the company and its verified legal facts
- [Privacy](https://sirenvenue.sk/en/privacy): how personal data is handled

## Work

- DOT. Gallery (client): https://dotgallery.sk
- COMMA gallery (client)
- BlinkLive (own project, live camera): https://blinklive.app
